purpose: Read-only inventory and schema determination for the parent work public benchmark; no instance is built and no solver is run here.

per_instance/distances.txt.evidence: Two columns observed in every file; values carry ~17 significant digits consistent with a float64 repr of a tree-derived distance. DecoDiPhy cli.py reads a bare (label, distance) table in exactly this form (decodiphy/cli.py: distances = {l[0]: float(l[1])}).

per_instance/estimated_distances_pr-h14_.evidence: Literal header row in the file; confirmed by find_sol_10k.py, which reads this file and takes est = float(d[1]), portion = float(d[2]) and true = float(d[3]).

Demixing__10k_dataset__dist.txt.evidence: Four key columns prepended by commands.sh-style awk (-v var1=tree var2=k var3=s var4=dist); the remaining four are the per-instance estimated-distance table, whose header is spelled out verbatim in krepp_distances.txt.

Demixing__10k_dataset__krepp_distances.t.header: one header row per instance group
Demixing__10k_dataset__krepp_distances.t.evidence: Header row repeated inside the file for every group.

Demixing__10k_dataset__krepp_placement_d.evidence: Six columns; row count per group equals the FULL tree leaf count (queries included), unlike the other files whose row count is full-minus-K.

Demixing__10k_dataset__truemash.txt.evidence: Six columns; equals the per-instance true_mash_distances.txt table with the four key columns prepended. find_sol_10k.py writes that per-instance file as (label, true distance) computed on the ANI branch-length tree.

Demixing__10k_dataset__all_metrics_est_m.evidence: Named verbatim by the authors' plotting script draw_10k.R: names(est_mash_corrected_data) <- c('tree', 'k', 's', 'dist', 'jaccard', 'unifrac', 'wunifrac', 'est_k', 'wasser', 'bc').

per_instance/read_counts_table-h14_dth.t.evidence: Literal header "#FeatureID\tESTIMATED"; values are a read-mapping-derived relative abundance ESTIMATE over reference genomes, not the ground-truth mixture.

per_instance/queries.txt.evidence: find_sol_10k.py reads queries.txt and takes true_p = [float(q[1]) for q in queries] with q[0] the query taxon label; k = len(queries).

read_counts.interpretation: krepp read-mapping ESTIMATE of relative abundance over reference genomes; NOT the ground-truth mixture
